csv_scope_of_work: The Griswold Housing Authority ( GHA ) is seeking a qualified firm to serve as Construction Manager at Risk for its proposed New Construction of McCluggage Manor Extension (the Project ). The Griswold Housing Authority (the GHA ) is seeking a qualified firm to serve as construction manager at risk (the CMR ) for GHA s proposed development of McCluggage Manor Extension (the Project ), a 29-unit senior affordable rental housing complex. The role will initially start as an advisor and cost estimator leading to a Construction Manager at-risk.
